chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the recitation in the Friday prayer when I pray alone four [rak'at], do I recite aloud? He said: 'Yes.' And he said: 'Recite with Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqun on the day of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on reciting aloud during Friday prayer when praying alone, and which Surahs are recommended?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms that reciting aloud is permissible even when praying alone, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the day through the specific recommendation of Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Al-Munafiqun. This practice highlights the thematic link between communal identity and the detection of hypocrisy, as both surahs address the state of the believers and the hypocrites within the Friday congregation. The ruling underscores the importance of maintaining the ritual's auditory and communal essence regardless of the number of worshippers.
